# Webasto Cool Top Trail for Home Assistant

Control your Houghton-made Webasto Cool Top Trail caravan or motorhome air conditioner from Home Assistant. Install through HACS and use an ESP32 with an infrared (IR) transmitter to send commands, just like the handheld remote.

**This integration is in development.** The software and remote signals have been tested; commands generated by the integration still need testing on the actual air conditioner. Compatibility with other Houghton models has not been confirmed.

## What you can control

- Power, cooling, heating, automatic heating/cooling, drying, and fan-only mode.
- Temperature in Celsius or Fahrenheit, fan speed, and Sleep mode.
- The air conditioner's panel display and panel control lock.
- Its daily on/off timers.

These appear as one climate control and a few additional controls. An optional room-temperature sensor can show the current temperature. Every command Home Assistant sends refreshes the appliance clock from HA local time; there is no separate clock-sync action.

## What you need

- Home Assistant **2026.10.1 or newer**, with HACS.
- ESPHome **2026.9.1 or newer**.
- An ESP32 with an IR transmitter, running this project's ESPHome configuration.
- Optionally, an IR receiver so Home Assistant can follow changes made with the handheld remote.

**No remote pairing or button learning is required.** You can use a transmitter alone. Infrared provides no confirmation from the air conditioner, so Home Assistant shows the last requested settings, rather than verified appliance status.

## Install

1. Follow the [installation guide](docs/installation.md) to prepare the ESP32 and connect it to Home Assistant.
2. In HACS, add `https://github.com/gszigethy/HA-Webasto-Cool-Top-Trail` as a **custom repository**, category **Integration**. Download it and restart Home Assistant.
3. Go to **Settings → Devices & services → Add integration** and search for **Webasto Cool Top Trail**.

The [setup walkthrough](docs/installation.md#4-add-webasto-cool-top-trail) explains what to select in every field, including the confusingly named **Received IR frame** sensor. If your ESP32 has no receiver, enable **Use default starting settings (transmitter only)**.
